messages.content: A mist from the sea engulfs a town. It takes 10 minutes for the mist to spread across every 3 miles of the town. If the distance from the seaside to the farthest inland boundary of the town is 42 miles, how many minutes will it take for the mist to completely envelop the town?

content.text: I need to find how many 3-mile increments fit into 42 miles, then multiply by 10 minutes.

content.title: What is 42 Divided by 3?  14
content.content: What is 42 Divided by 3? = 14｡+ 42 divided by 3 equals 14. As a decimal it is 14. How do you show the work for 42 ÷ 3?+ Set up with 3 on the left and 42 under the bracket. 3 goes into 42 exactly 14 times since 3 × 14 = 42. Subtract 42 from 42 to get remainder 0. What is 42 divided by 3 as a fraction?+ 42/3 simplifies to 14. Is 42 divisible by 3?+ Yes — 42 divides exactly by 3 with no remainder. To check if 42 is divisible by 3, add its digits: 4 + 2 = 6. Since 6 is divisible by 3, 42 is also divisible by 3. What is 42 divided by 3 as a decimal?+ 42 ÷ 3 as a decimal is 14. This is a terminating decimal — it ends without repeating.

content.title: 42 Divided by 3
content.content: 42 Divided by 3 STEM Calculators｡In math algebra, what is 42 divided by 3, and how can the result be checked? Subject: Math Algebra Chapter: Numbers Topic: PEMDAS Rule Answer included Written by STEM Calculators Tutor Published January 22, 2026 Updated January 22, 2026 Discover more Teaching & Classroom Resources Mathematics Educational Resources 42 divided by 3 42 ÷ 3 divide 42 by 3 quotient division facts equal groups fraction form verify division Accepted answer Answer included Compute 42 Divided by 3 The expression 42 divided by 3 means the quotient \(42 \div 3\). In math algebra, division can be interpreted as splitting a total into equal groups. Here, 42 is split into 3 equal parts. Meaning: \(42 \div 3\) asks, “If 42 is shared equally among 3 groups, how many are in each group?” Step 1: Write division as a fraction \[ 42 \div 3 = \frac{42}{3} \] Step 2: Perform the division Since \(3 \cdot 14 = 42\), the quotient is 14: \[ \frac{42}{3} = 14 \] Result: \(\boxed{14}\). Step 3: Verify by multiplication A quick check uses the inverse operation (multiplication): \[ 3 \cdot 14 = 42 \] Summary table Form Expression Value Division \(42 \div 3\) \(14\) Fraction \(\dfrac{42}{3}\) \(14\) Check \(3 \cdot 14\) \(42\) Visualization: 42 split into 3 equal groups (no overlap) Division as equal groups: 42 split into 3 equal parts Total 42 ÷ 3 Group 1 14 Group 2 14 Group 3 14 Each group must be the same size, so the quotient is the common group size. Check (plain text): 3 × 14 = 42. The figure shows 42 partitioned into 3 equal groups. Each group contains 14, so \(42 \div 3 = 14\). Division is a mathematical operation that consists of determining how many times a number (the divisor, 42) is contained in another number (the dividend, 3). The result of this operation is called the quotient. Asking for the quotient of 42 and 3 is the same of getting the result of 42 divided by 3, which can be displayed in several ways: Floating point number 14 Rational number 14/1 Mixed number 14 0/1 Euclidean division 14 remainder 0 Integer quotient 14 42 divided by 3, step by step Step 1 Set up the division: position the divisor (3) on the left and the dividend (42) on the right. 3 ) 4 2 Step 2 Determine how many times 3 can be multiplied without exceeding the dividend (4). The answer is 1. Place this digit on top. 1 3 ) 4 2 Step 3 Multiply the divisor by the previous result (3 × 1 = 3). Write the new result below the dividend. 1 3 ) 4 2 3 Step 4 Subtract this result from the number above it (4 - 3 = 1). Write the difference below. 1 3 ) 4 2 3 1 Step 5 Bring down the next digit of the dividend (2) down. 1 3 ) 4 2 3 1 2 Step 6 Determine how many times 3 can be multiplied without exceeding the dividend (12). The answer is 4. Place this digit on top. 1 4 3 ) 4 2 3 1 2 Step 7 Multiply the divisor by the previous result (3 × 4 = 12).
